comparison.objective: Candidate removes open cartons and passes closed cartons; PR-1493 performs an oil-dipstick inspection, reports the level, and restores the tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic carton grasping and low-tilt transport versus handle-only dipstick extraction, wiping, reinsertion, visual reading, and report-token placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades routing, retained contents, release clearance, and stable dwell; PR-1493 grades the wipe/reseat/read sequence, correct level report, final reseating, and tool release, with guessing or a wrong report failing.
comparison.reason: The inspection sequence and slender-tool manipulation are unrelated to selective loaded-carton handling.
